people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
translations.bsb: “Far be it!” Joab declared. “Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
